column1: # findings-supersession.tsv - THE ONE AUTHORED INPUT TO THE LEDGER.
# Everything else in `research/findings.sqlite` is regenerated from the markdown
# by `research/tools/fledger.py`. This file is not, because F669 measured the
# obvious derivation rule at +76% over the truth: it degenerates into (a
# retraction word appears in this block) x (every finding the block cites), and
# findings cite each other in 289 of 999 rows. So supersession is READ and
# WRITTEN DOWN, once, with the sentence that proves it.
#   src       the finding doing the correcting. MAY BE BLANK - not every
#             correction in this archive was made by a numbered finding. Some
#             are editorial ("Do not quote F488's raw 26.71 GiB"), and inventing
#             a finding to be the author would be a fabricated fact.
#   kind      supersedes  the earlier claim is replaced; do not quote it
#             retracts    the earlier claim is withdrawn, nothing replaces it
#             refines     the earlier finding STANDS; part of it is qualified
#             answers     the earlier finding posed a question that is now shut
#             not-an-edge the prose explicitly says this correction did NOT
#                         happen. Stored so the next heuristic cannot assert it.
#   reason    why, in one line, in the archive's own words where possible
#   evidence  doc:line of the sentence that proves it. Not optional.
# STATUS OF THIS FILE, stated so nobody quotes it as complete:
# first pass, 2026-09-08. F669 counted 38 correction edges in the prose by hand.
# This file holds the ones a directed search surfaced AND a human then read and
# evidenced: 17 edges and 10 non-edges. The remainder are not denied, they are
# unread - `fledger.py candidates` is the worklist. DO NOT quote the edge count
# here as the archive's total number of corrections.
